versions.changelog:
Initial release of yq-bilibili-skill.

- Provides CLI commands for Bilibili video details, subtitles (with timeline and SRT export), AI summaries, comments, related videos, and recommendations.
- Supports audio extraction and splitting into ASR-ready WAV or keeping full m4a, with custom segment length and output directory.
- Enables fetching and searching Bilibili user info, user video list, following list, favorites, watch-later, and viewing history.
- Includes commands for site-wide/hot video finding, keyword/user search, and dynamic feeds with pagination.
- Allows interactive actions: like, coin, triple (点赞+投币+收藏), and unfollow.
- Handles login/QR authentication, credential management, and permission checks.
- All commands support YAML and JSON output for easy data integration and AI processing.
- Provides troubleshooting tips, installation instructions, and comprehensive usage examples.
